notes: Chief routes every task; no agent fans a message out to every other agent.
At most three agents work on one task at once; beyond three or four, each agent's share of the budget gets too thin to help.
One live instance per bot: the Cstack session refuses a second live session for the same bot and domain (LedgerStoreClaim in adapters/aor_session.py).

owner_only.step: Saying go or confirm on a goal, a plan or a release
Approving any ask-class effect: send, payment, post, filing or delete
Raising a budget, a spending limit or a paid or real model run
Freezing or amending an experiment PRECOMMIT or RESULT after it merges
Editing aors/fleet.json, agents/ definitions or the generated .claude/agents/ files
Merging a pull request into the main branch

artifacts.name: intent
artifacts.format: Plain-language objective, acceptance criteria and constraints, recorded with POODO start_goal

artifacts.name: status_brief
artifacts.format: Plain-language status: what changed, what is blocked, which decisions are the owner's

artifacts.name: decision_record
artifacts.format: POODO capsule: options considered, the precommit hash, the decision and its reversal condition

artifacts.name: expected_values
artifacts.format: Foundation tool outputs with their receipts; status CHECK until the owner approves them

artifacts.name: spec
artifacts.format: EndoForge job spec: CONTRACT.md, tests.json, job.json and atoms.json, frozen before any build

artifacts.name: candidate
artifacts.format: A promoted candidate (branch or diff) with its EndoForge run receipt

artifacts.name: escalation
artifacts.format: A conductor escalation (NEEDS-COORDINATOR) with the run id and the one blocking question

artifacts.name: verdict
artifacts.format: Pass or fail per check, with the independent signal used and the evidence it produced

artifacts.name: precommit
artifacts.format: PRECOMMIT with a reserved experiment id, prediction, success boundary and content hash

artifacts.name: result
artifacts.format: RESULT for one experiment id, measured against its PRECOMMIT

artifacts.name: check
artifacts.format: A deterministic check (test, lint rule or gate) that turns one lesson into a failure the next run sees

artifacts.name: lesson
artifacts.format: One correction, its root cause and the check or change that removes it

artifacts.name: health_report
artifacts.format: Health, capacity, budget burn and pin drift, each with the command that measured it

artifacts.name: pin_change
artifacts.format: A repin in its own pull request, with the old and new pins and their receipts

assistant.purpose: Drafts messages, replies and calendar text; never sends

money.purpose: Reads statements and budgets and drafts payments for approval; never pays

research.purpose: Answers questions from sources and labels what is unverified

home-ops.purpose: Keeps home devices, services and chores running and reports drift

security.purpose: Reviews permissions, secrets and exposure and proposes fixes

domain-specialist.purpose: Owns one domain through a new Foundation's tools
